ms.report:
A. Output: MVP Functional Deployment
Fully functional MVP deployed on Cardano testnet implementing all five core features: private order placement via SHA-256 ZK commitments with 128-bit secret nonces, ZK proof generation and on-chain verification across five Midnight Compact contracts (order, matching, settlement, liquidation, aggregate), end-to-end matching and settlement, liquidation and position close-out with margin breach detection, and full integration with the Midnight privacy layer. The MVP includes a live frontend marketplace UI with step-by-step pipeline visualization, and backend APIs with Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, served from a single same-origin tunnel.
Acceptance criteria: MVP operates end-to-end on Cardano testnet with 9 successful transactions (7 Midnight ZK + 2 Cardano Preprod) covering order placement, matching, settlement, liquidation, and aggregated proof bundling across blocks 46574–46611.
